title: Mobile App Developer
company: PTC Circle IT Services Pvt Ltd
description:
About the role

PTC RoboMax is hiring a Mobile App Developer to build and maintain its Android and iOS applications. The developer will work with the ERP team to bring workflows such as curriculum access, assessments, and reporting to mobile users.

**Key responsibilities**

* Build, test, release, and maintain features for Android and iOS.
* Integrate the apps with ERP APIs for sign-in, role-based access, assessments, reporting, and notifications.
* Work with the ERP team to turn school and internal requirements into straightforward mobile workflows.
* Handle intermittent connectivity with clear error messages, retry options, and safeguards against duplicate submissions.
* Diagnose crashes, fix bugs, and improve performance across supported devices.
* Implement secure session management and protect school and student data handled by the apps.
* Manage app builds, signing, testing, and releases through Google Play Console and App Store Connect.

**Candidate profile**

* 2–4 years of mobile development experience, with at least one production release on each platform.
* Proficiency in Flutter or React Native, or native development with Kotlin for Android and Swift for iOS.
* Experience with REST APIs, authentication, local storage, push notifications, and Git.
* Familiarity with mobile debugging, testing, and app store release workflows.
* Experience with ERP or EdTech apps, offline workflows, or Firebase is preferred.

**About PTC Circle IT Services Pvt. Ltd.**

Established in 2010 in Rohtak, Haryana, **PTC Circle IT Services Pvt. Ltd.** provides technology solutions and educational services to schools across Northern India. Its offerings include school management ERP, web and mobile application development, online examination software, and smart classroom solutions. The company supports clients across the software lifecycle, from design and development to implementation, testing, and ongoing support.

**Mobile App Developer – Android & iOS**  
**Location -** Rohtak  
**Employment Type -**  Full Time  
**Work Mode -**  Work from Office  
**Experience -** 2-4 Years

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹960,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Business Unit Head-EDTECH
description:
**Job Title**: Business Unit Head-EDTECH

**Company:** Dexter Venture Private Limited  
**Business Division:** Play9  
**Experience:** 4+ Years

**About Dexter Venture Private Limited**

Dexter Venture Private Limited is one of India's leading firms in the business of musical instruments, professional audio equipment, and content creation devices. We cater to the growing needs of musicians, creators, studios, and audio professionals by offering a diverse range of products and solutions.

**About Play9**

Play9 is a new consumer technology venture backed by Dexter Ventures, bringing the company's strong industry expertise and established e-commerce presence into a new technology-led consumer business in music.

Play9 aims to build a digital platform that connects customers with music-related services through a seamless booking experience. We are looking for an entrepreneurial and technology-oriented professional who can take ownership of this venture and build it from the ground up with a co-founder mindset.

**What We Offer**

* An entrepreneurial leadership opportunity with ownership from day one.
* Direct working exposure with the founders.
* Competitive compensation package along with meaningful equity participation.
* The opportunity to build and lead a new consumer technology venture.
* Strong business backing from an established leader in the music and professional audio industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product & Technology Management**

* Take complete ownership of the development of Play9's mobile application, customer booking website, and internal operations dashboard.
* Define product requirements, features, user journeys, and development priorities.
* Select appropriate technology platforms and tools to build scalable digital solutions.
* Prepare clear product briefs and coordinate with freelance designers and developers.
* Manage development timelines, budgets, and product delivery.

**2. Technology Integration & Product Development**

* Oversee the integration of essential services such as maps, payment gateways, OTP verification, and WhatsApp messaging.
* Ensure smooth coordination between the mobile application, booking website, and operations dashboard.
* Conduct product testing with real users before launch.
* Continuously improve the platform based on user feedback and business requirements.

**3. Business Launch & Growth**

* Lead the end-to-end launch of Play9 in the market.
* Identify and develop supply-side partnerships and service provider networks.
* Drive customer acquisition and build early traction.
* Develop go-to-market strategies and execute launch plans.
* Identify opportunities to expand the business and strengthen market presence.

**4. Business Operations & Performance**

* Monitor business performance, unit economics, and key operational metrics.
* Define and track launch milestones and business objectives.
* Ensure efficient execution across product development, technology, and business operations.
* Work closely with the founders on strategic planning and business growth.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate or postgraduate degree from a Tier-1 college or university.
* Minimum 4 years of experience in consumer technology, product development, app-based businesses, or D2C marketing.
* Experience in building, launching, or managing a mobile application or website.
* Strong understanding of digital products, technology platforms, and consumer-facing applications.
* Experience working with freelance developers, designers, or external technology teams.
* Familiarity with no-code/low-code tools such as FlutterFlow, Firebase, Retool, or Webflow will be preferred.
* Ability to define product requirements and translate business ideas into technology solutions.
* Strong business understanding, problem-solving ability, and execution skills.
* A genuine interest in technology, entrepreneurship, and building new businesses.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Someone who has successfully built or launched a product, application, website, or business from scratch.
* A self-driven professional with an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong sense of ownership.
* Someone who can independently manage technology development as well as business execution.
* A professional who is comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment and taking responsibility for outcomes.

**The Opportunity**

This is an opportunity to build a new consumer technology business from the ground up, work directly with the founders, and play a key role in shaping the future of Play9.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
**Job Description – Mobile Application Developer**

**Position:** Mobile Application Developer  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Reporting To:** IT / Software Development

**About the Role**

We are seeking a skilled, innovative, and result-oriented Mobile Application Developer to join our technology team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining high-performance mobile applications that deliver seamless user experiences across platforms.

This role requires a strong understanding of mobile application architecture, modern development frameworks, API integrations, and performance optimisation. The candidate should possess a passion for technology, an analytical mindset, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable and reliable mobile solutions.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain robust mobile applications for Android and iOS platforms.
* Build intuitive, responsive, and user-centric application interfaces while maintaining high standards of usability and performance.
* Develop clean, scalable, reusable, and well-documented code in accordance with industry best practices.
* Integrate RESTful APIs, third-party services, payment gateways, and other external systems.
* Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, backend developers, product managers, and other stakeholders.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve application bugs, performance bottlenecks, and technical issues.
* Implement appropriate security measures to safeguard application data and user information.
* Ensure compatibility across multiple devices, operating systems, and screen resolutions.
* Conduct application testing, debugging, and performance optimisation before deployment.
* Manage application releases, updates, and maintenance through the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
* Stay informed about emerging technologies, development tools, and evolving mobile application standards.
* Contribute to technical discussions and continuously improve development workflows.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in mobile application development using Flutter, React Native, Kotlin, Swift, or relevant technologies.
* Strong understanding of Android and/or iOS application development.
* Experience in API integration, JSON handling, and backend communication.
* Familiarity with Firebase, push notifications, authentication, and cloud-based services.
* Understanding of databases such as SQLite, MySQL, Firebase, or MongoDB.
* Knowledge of Git, GitHub, Bitbucket, or other version control systems.
* Strong understanding of application architecture, debugging, and performance optimisation.
* Familiarity with application deployment and publishing procedures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in mobile application development.
* A portfolio of published applications or demonstrable project experience.
* Experience working in an Agile or collaborative software development environment.
* Understanding of secure coding practices and mobile application lifecycle management.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent technical communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage multiple development priorities effectively.
* Attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality solutions.
* Proactive approach towards learning and adopting new technologies.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a team environment.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on innovative and impactful technology projects.
* A collaborative and growth-oriented professional environment.
* Exposure to modern development tools, frameworks, and technologies.
* Opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation aligned with skills and experience.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Software Development Engineer-II
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Introduction to the Team:**

This role is under Platform Quality team \& We are looking for high performing individual contributor who has worked prior on or willing to work on Scalable internal tools \& utilities creation for developer productivity enhancement.


Must have developed Internal or industry standard based web or native app test automation solution which is highly stable \& scalable.


**In this role, you will:**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust test automation frameworks, internal tools, and utilities that leverage AI/ML‑enabled solutions to enhance developer productivity and accelerate release cycles.
* Write clean, maintainable, and optimized code using strong knowledge of software design principles, data structures, design patterns, and computer science fundamentals across multiple tech stacks including native mobile apps, web, and APIs.
* Investigate and perform root cause analysis (RCA) of test failures and system issues, using deep understanding of the surrounding systems, logs, and monitoring to design and implement durable fixes.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve test coverage, failure detection, and feedback loops, while ensuring reliability, observability, and maintainability of these solutions in production workflows.
* Utilize and refine industry‑standard test automation frameworks, CI/CD workflows (such as GitHub Actions), and operational tooling (such as RCP/MCP servers, Datadog, Splunk) to continuously improve quality and efficiency.
* Collaborate across teams to identify and resolve inefficiencies in code, tools, and processes, driving cross‑organizational improvements, documenting major technical initiatives (including RCAs), and sharing learnings with broader groups.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
* 2\+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Professional software development or test automation engineering experience, including building and debugging applications and internal tools, with strength in at least one programming language and exposure to multiple technology implementations.
* Working knowledge of industry‑standard testing and monitoring tools for automated and distributed systems, and the ability to interpret system behavior and logs to perform effective RCA of failures.
* Ability to design and implement code and framework changes that improve stability, reliability, and test effectiveness across services or components, including familiarity with CI/CD workflows and observability tooling.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing software, automation frameworks, or internal tools in at least two programming languages (such as Java and Python), including designing and maintaining test automation systems or high‑usage internal utilities from scratch.
* Proven ability to apply design patterns for scalable, maintainable systems and frameworks, including system design (low‑level design), API design, and data modeling for test and tooling platforms.
* Demonstrated impact in selecting appropriate technologies and architectures to solve business and quality needs, connecting team goals to broader business outcomes and identifying project‑level business problems with corresponding technical solutions.
* Familiarity with AI‑driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve test automation, developer workflows, or quality insights.
* Experience operating test automation and internal tooling at scale, including optimizing CI/CD pipelines, observability (Datadog, Splunk), and reliability for multi‑service or cross‑platform environments.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
